items.title: Harold Christophe Interview, 1961-08-01
items.q: So whenever that band was playing... he'd come right there and pull you out and tell you this is what you made wrong.

ctx.x: He just was that sensitive. So we called him Hawkeye. Hawkeye? Yeah, we called him. Martin. Yeah, Hawkeye. But you can see in you. So yeah, he wouldn't miss. So whenever that band was playing, don't think you're going to make something wrong, then he ain't going to know. He'd come right there and pull you out and tell you this is what you made wrong.
Yeah. Can you tell us anything about the first bands you ever played in? Did you ever play with anybody with your guitar before you took up sax? Did you ever hit bands or anything else?
